title: College Group Selection Career Roadmap
problem: Class 10 hostel friends choose college groups (MPC, BiPC, CEC) blindly because their classmates picked them, and regret it later.
idea: A group finder. Pick what you enjoy most and see which Intermediate group fits you and where it can lead.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: What do I enjoy most?
widgets.intro: This is a starting idea only. Talk to your teachers and parents before deciding.
widgets.question: My favourite thing to learn is…

options.label: Maths and machines
options.result: MPC (Maths, Physics, Chemistry). Leads to Engineering, B.Sc, Polytechnic, Architecture.

options.label: Plants, animals and the body
options.result: BiPC (Biology, Physics, Chemistry). Leads to Nursing, Pharmacy, Agriculture, Medicine, B.Sc.
options.te: BiPC – నర్సింగ్, ఫార్మసీ, వ్యవసాయం, వైద్యం వైపు.

options.label: Money, shops and business
options.result: CEC (Civics, Economics, Commerce) or MEC (Maths, Economics, Commerce). Leads to B.Com, CA, Banking.
options.te: CEC / MEC – బీకామ్, సీఏ, బ్యాంకింగ్ వైపు.

options.label: History, people and society
options.result: HEC (History, Economics, Civics). Leads to B.A., Law, Teaching, Civil Services.

options.label: Working with my hands
options.result: Look at Polytechnic diploma or ITI after Class 10. Quick skills and jobs!

questions.q: What is the best reason to choose a group?
questions.why: You will study it for 2 years – choose what you enjoy and are good at.

questions.q: Which group usually leads to Nursing and Pharmacy?
questions.why: BiPC has Biology, needed for health courses.

questions.q: Who should you talk to before deciding?
questions.why: People who know you can guide you well.

how: Write your Class 9/10 marks and your favourite subjects on paper.
Enter them into Gemini and ask which Intermediate groups suit you and why.
Ask Gemini for a simple roadmap: group → degree → jobs.
Check the suggestions with your teacher.
Make a one-page guidance sheet in Canva for each group.
Share the sheets with Class 10 friends in the hostel.
prompt: I am a Class 10 student in Telangana. My marks: Maths 85, Science 70, Social 90, English 75. I love reading history and talking to people. Suggest suitable Intermediate groups (MPC, BiPC, CEC, MEC, HEC) with a simple career roadmap for each.
